purpose: Investigate the 10.rcp point-count difference using local source comparison and official Autodesk project-edit documentation

official_autodesk_context.title: How to export and save parts of a ReCap Pro project
official_autodesk_context.documented_behavior: Save keeps deleted points invisible and recoverable; Save As can permanently remove deleted points and reduce file size while retaining scan locations.

official_autodesk_context.title: Project is empty when opening in ReCap
official_autodesk_context.documented_behavior: An RCP project links associated RCS scan data and expects its support folder and scan files to remain available.

interpretation.hypothesis: A project manifest can retain a count from an earlier scan state while a saved or exported linked RCS has a different physical point count; ReCap edit history or stale metadata could contribute.
interpretation.not_proven: The Autodesk articles do not specify NumPoints semantics or explain this exact +244259 difference. The nearby 10.rcs is not the source that matches the RCP declaration.
interpretation.next_acceptance: Open the exact RCP and linked support folder in ReCap, inspect project history/scan status, and compare the displayed scan count or export a non-destructive copy for reader comparison.
